default_entry accepts a 1-based index or an entry path with '/' separators (example 'OSes/Arch Linux'); remember_last_entry (UEFI only) takes precedence over default_entry; a value naming a directory or nothing disables autoboot; global options must precede the first entry. Config search order includes /boot/limine.conf.

old_claim: kernel module reports loaded, but aa-status says the AppArmor filesystem is not mounted
